21601.commentary: (APt) dvayaṃ khuddaghaṇṭikāyaṃ. kiṃ kucchitaṃ kaṇatī'ti kiṅkaṇī, nad'ādi. kiṅkiṇī'ti'pi pāṭh'antaraṃ, tadā yadādi.

examples.text: paggayha kiṅkaṇiṃ pupphaṃ, vipassiss'ābhiropayiṃ, udaggacitto sumano, dvipad'indassa tādino.

21602.meaning2: Crotalaria pulcherrima tree with bell-like flowers

examples.text: disvā sārathiṃ āmantesi, ayaṃ pana, samma sārathi, puriso kiṅ'kato? kesā'pi'ssa na yathā aññesaṃ, kāyo'pi'ssa na yathā aññesan'ti.

21605.meaning1: thing which must be done; task to be performed; duties to be done
21605.commentary: (ANa) kiṃkaraṇīyānī'ti iti kattabbāni. (ANa) kiṃkaraṇīyānī'ti kiṃ karomī'ti evaṃ vatvā kattabbakammāni.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṅ'karaṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato, alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.

21606.meaning1: willing and able; agreeing to do what the other wants; following instructions obediently
21606.meaning2: willing and able; agreeing to do what the other wants; following instructions obediently
21606.commentary: (MNa) kiṃ karomi devā'ti tassa kiṃkāraṃ paṭissāvetī'ti kiṃkārapaṭissāvinī.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, mahārāja, idha te assa puriso dāso kammakāro pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṅ'kārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī mukh'ullokiko. tassa evam'assa, acchariyaṃ, vata bho, abbhutaṃ, vata bho, puññānaṃ gati, puññānaṃ vipāko.

dhammo, ānanda, pāsādo dvīhi kiṅkiṇikajālehi parikkhitto ahosi, ekaṃ jālaṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ. sovaṇṇamayassa jālassa rūpiyamayā kiṅkiṇikā ahesuṃ, rūpiyamayassa jālassa sovaṇṇamayā kiṅkiṇikā ahesuṃ.

21608.meaning1: sound of a bell; tinkling of a bell
21608.commentary: (VINa) kiṅkaṇikasaddo'ti kiṅkaṇikajālassa saddo. yathā kira nānāratanehi katassa kiṅkaṇikajālassa saddo hoti, evaṃ tassā kuṭikāya vātapān'antarik'ādīhi paviṭṭhena vātena samāhatāya saddo ahosi. eten'assā anto ca bahi ca supakkabhāvo dassito hoti.

examples.text: dhammo, ānanda, pāsādo dvīhi kiṅkiṇikajālehi parikkhitto ahosi, ekaṃ jālaṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ ekaṃ rūpiyamayaṃ. sovaṇṇamayassa jālassa rūpiyamayā kiṅkiṇikā ahesuṃ, rūpiyamayassa jālassa sovaṇṇamayā kiṅkiṇikā ahesuṃ.

21611.meaning2: Crotalaria pulcherrima tree with bell-like flowers

examples.text: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṅ'kusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo ten'upasaṅkamiṃ

21613.commentary: (DNa) kiṃ kusal'ānuesī'ti kiṃ kusalan'ti anuesanto pariyesanto. tattha, kiṃ kusalan'ti sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ adhippetaṃ, taṃ gavesanto'ti attho.

examples.text: ek'ūnatiṃso vayasā subhadda, yaṃ pabbajiṃ kiṅ'kusal'ānuesī, vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni, yato ahaṃ pabbajito subhadda, ñāyassa dhammassa padesavattī, ito bahiddhā samaṇo'pi n'atthi.

21614.meaning1: having what destination? going to what? going where?
21614.commentary: (SNt) kīdisā gati nibbatti etissā'ti kiṃgatikā, kiṃniṭṭhā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

21615.commentary: (THa) purisakiccānī'ti vīrapurisena kattabbāni attahitaparahitāni. (JAa) karaṃ purisakiccānī'ti yathā so puggalo purisehi kattabbāni kammāni karaṃ pacchākāle na ca anutappati, yathā n'ānusocati, ev'āham'pi vīriyaṃ karonto pacchākāle n'ānutappāmi n'ānusocāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo ca sītañ'ca uṇhañ'ca, tiṇā bhiyyo na maññati, karaṃ purisakiccāni, so sukhā na vihāyati.
yo ca etāni ṭhānāni, yoniso paṭipajjati, karaṃ purisakiccāni, sa pacchā n'ānutappatī'ti.

21616.meaning1: should be done; ought to be made (by)

examples.text: yaṃ vo kiccaṃ sarīrena, taṃ karotha yadicchatha, na me tappaccayā tattha, doso pemañ'ca hehiti.
tumhehi kiccam'ātappaṃ, akkhātāro tathāgatā, paṭipannā pamokkhanti, jhāyino mārabandhanā.
lakkhaṇ'ādīsu ca tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvo vā sāmaññaṃ vā lakkhaṇaṃ nāma, kiccaṃ vā sampatti vā raso nāma, upaṭṭhān'ākāro vā phalaṃ vā paccupaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, āsannakāraṇaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ nāma.
nidhiṃ nidheti puriso, gambhīre odak'antike, atthe kicce samuppanne, atthāya me bhavissati.

21619.meaning1: (gram) primary derivative; affix added to roots to form potential participles; e.g. -anīya, -tabba, etc.
21619.meaning2: (gram) affix added to roots to form potential particles e.g. -anīya, -tabba, etc.; primary derivative

21620.meaning1: doing what should be done; fulfilling one's obligations; doing what is necessary
21620.meaning2: doing what should be done, doing one's duty; serving a purpose, useful
21620.commentary: (SNa) kiccakaro ca hotī'ti attanā kattabbakiccakaro c'eva kusalakiccakaro ca, bhuñjati ca, kamm'ante ca payojeti, dānañ'ca detī'ti attho. (ANa) kiccakaro'ti uppannānaṃ kiccānaṃ kārako.

examples.text: dhīro ca viññū adhigamma bhoge, so bhuñjati kiccakaro ca hoti, so ñātisaṅghaṃ nisabho bharitvā, anindito saggam'upeti ṭhānan'ti.
mātāpitukiccakaro, puttadārahito sadā, antojanassa atthāya, ye c'assa anujīvino.

21621.meaning1: work to be done; duties to do
21621.commentary: (ANa) kiccakaraṇīyānī'ti ettha avassaṃ kattabbāni kiccāni, itarāni karaṇīyāni.

examples.text: idha, gahapati, ekacco gihīhi saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā tesu yogaṃ āpajjati. evaṃ kho, gahapati, gāme santhavajāto hoti.
santi hi, moggallāna, kulesu kiccakaraṇīyāni

21622.meaning1: doing what should be done; doing what ought to be done (with)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu so puriso evaṃkārī tasmiṃ kulle kiccakārī assā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

21623.meaning1: who has done one's duty (towards); who has done the job

examples.text: nibbāne ca santadassāvī bhavissāmi, anusayā ca me samugghātaṃ gacchissanti, kiccakārī ca bhavissāmi, satthā ca me pariciṇṇo bhavissati mettāvatāyā'ti.

21624.meaning1: effort should be made (by); one should strive
21624.commentary: (MNa) ajj'eva kiccam'ātappan'ti kilesānaṃ ātāpanaparitāpanena ātappan'ti laddhanāmaṃ vīriyaṃ ajj'eva kātabbaṃ.

examples.text: ajj'eva kiccam'ātappaṃ, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve, na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
tumhehi kiccam'ātappaṃ, akkhātāro tathāgatā, paṭipannā pamokkhanti, jhāyino mārabandhanā.

21627.meaning1: right and wrong; good and bad
21627.meaning2: what should be done and not be done
21627.meaningLit: what should and shouldn't be done

examples.text: mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'ev'ātivasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici. iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.
yassa ca visatā n'atthi, chinnasotassa bhikkhuno, kicc'ākiccappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.

21629.meaning1: case involving obligations; (comm) issue regarding legal actions
21629.commentary: (VINa) yā saṅghassa kiccayatā karaṇīyatā apalokanakammaṃ ñattikammaṃ ñattidutiyakammaṃ ñatticatutthakamman'ti evaṃ catubbidhaṃ saṅghakiccaṃ kicc'ādhikaraṇan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: adhikaraṇaṃ nāma cattāri adhikaraṇāni, vivād'ādhikaraṇaṃ, anuvād'ādhikaraṇaṃ, āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ, kicc'ādhikaraṇaṃ.

21630.meaning1: full of excuses for what should be done

examples.text: tassa evaṃ kicc'āpadesabahulassa viharato anuppannā c'eva bhogā n'uppajjanti, uppannā ca bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
kiccho manussapaṭilābho, kicchaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ, kicchaṃ saddhammassavanaṃ, kiccho buddhānam'uppādo.
imesañ'ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī

21632.commentary: (SNa) anuppannesu kicchesū'ti ito satt'āh'accayena yāni dukkhāni uppajjissanti, tesu.

examples.text: kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ loko āpanno, jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca upapajjati ca, atha ca pan'imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarāmaraṇassa
niccaṃ utrastam'idaṃ cittaṃ, niccaṃ ubbiggam'idaṃ mano, anuppannesu kicchesu, atho uppatitesu ca, sace atthi anutrastaṃ, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.

21635.meaning1: obtaining with great difficulty; only getting with great trouble
21635.meaning2: obtaining with great difficulty; only with great trouble

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu y'āyaṃ kathā ābhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā… evarūpiyā kathāya na nikāmalābhī hoti kicchalābhī kasiralābhī, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.

21636.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of kiccha

examples.text: kicchā laddho ayaṃ putto, sukhumālo sukh'edhito, imaṃ dadāma te nātha, jinassa paricārakaṃ.
evaṃ kicchā bhato poso, mātu aparicārako, mātari micchā caritvāna, nirayaṃ so'papajjati.

21637.meaning1: having the meaning of 'causing a difficult livelihood'

21639.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of kiccha

examples.text: sace enti manussattaṃ, dalidde jāyare kule, coḷaṃ piṇḍo ratī khiḍḍā, yattha kicchena labbhati.
dubbaco'ti dukkhena kicchena vaditabbo, na sakkā sukhena vattun'ti attho.
kiñ'ca vedeti? sukham'pi vedeti, dukkham'pi vedeti, adukkham'asukham'pi vedeti. vedeti vedetī'ti kho, āvuso, tasmā vedanā'ti vuccatī'ti.
kiñ'ca, ānanda, suññaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā? cakkhu kho, ānanda, suññaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā. rūpā suññā attena vā attaniyena vā
putto ty'āhaṃ mahārāja, tvaṃ maṃ posa janādhipa, aññe'pi devo poseti, kiñ'ca devo sakaṃ pajan'ti.

21643.commentary: (MNt) kiñcatī'ti kattari paṭhito dhātu maddanatthoti āha kiñcati maddatī'ti. tassa payogaṃ dassetuṃ manussā kirā'ti-ādi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: rāgo kho bhante kiñcanan'ti rāgo uppajjitvā puggalaṃ kiñcati maddati palibundhati, tasmā kiñcanan'ti vutto. manussā kira goṇehi khalaṃ maddāpentā kiñcehi kapila kiñcehi kāḷakā'ti vadanti.
n'āssa hirī na ottappaṃ, na vāco hoti gāravo, kodhena abhibhūtassa, na dīpaṃ hoti kiñcanaṃ.
kāmesu vinaya gedhaṃ, nekkhammaṃ daṭṭhu khemato, uggahītaṃ nirattaṃ vā, mā te vijjittha kiñcanaṃ.
duddasaṃ anataṃ nāma, na hi saccaṃ sudassanaṃ, paṭividdhā taṇhā jānato, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
yassa n'atthi idaṃ me'ti, paresaṃ vā'pi kiñcanaṃ, mamattaṃ so asaṃvindaṃ, n'atthi me'ti na socati.

21646.meaning1: owning; having something; possession; worldly attachment
21646.commentary: (MNa) mama kismiñci kiñcanaṃ n'atthī'ti so parassa attā mama kismiñci kiñcanabhāve atthī'ti na passati. attano bhātiṭṭhāne bhātaraṃ sahāyaṭṭhāne sahāyaṃ parikkhāraṭṭhāne vā parikkhāran'ti kismiñci ṭhāne parassa attānaṃ iminā kiñcanabhāvena upanetabbaṃ na passatī'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, n'āhaṃ kvacani kassaci kiñcanat'asmiṃ, na ca mama kvacani kismiñci kiñcanaṃ n'atthī'ti.

21649.meaning1: possession of this; ownership in this
21649.commentary: (MNa) kiñcanat'asmin'ti attano attānaṃ kassaci parassa kiñcanabhāve upanetabbaṃ na passati, attano bhātiṭṭhāne bhātaraṃ sahāyaṭṭhāne sahāyaṃ parikkhāraṭṭhāne vā parikkhāraṃ maññitvā upagantvā upanetabbaṃ na passatī'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, n'āhaṃ kvacani kassaci kiñcanat'asmiṃ, na ca mama kvacani kismiñci kiñcanaṃ n'atthī'ti.

21650.meaning1: possession; ownership (of); fact of having something
21650.construction:
kiṃ + ci + ana + tā
kiñcana + tā
21650.commentary: (MNa) kiñcanat'asmin'ti attano attānaṃ kassaci parassa kiñcanabhāve upanetabbaṃ na passati, attano bhātiṭṭhāne bhātaraṃ sahāyaṭṭhāne sahāyaṃ parikkhāraṭṭhāne vā parikkhāraṃ maññitvā upagantvā upanetabbaṃ na passatī'ti attho.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, n'āhaṃ kvacani kassaci kiñcanat'asmiṃ, na ca mama kvacani kismiñci kiñcanaṃ n'atthī'ti.
attano bhātiṭṭhāne bhātaraṃ sahāyaṭṭhāne sahāyaṃ parikkhāraṭṭhāne vā parikkhāran'ti kismiñci ṭhāne parassa attānaṃ iminā kiñcanabhāvena upanetabbaṃ na passatī'ti attho.

21653.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of kiñcana
21653.meaning1: anything at all; in any way
21653.construction:
kiṃ + ci + ana + aṃ
kiñcana + aṃ

examples.text: sato sampajāno mā me kvacani katthaci kiñcanaṃ rajanīyesu dhammesu rāgo udapādi, mā me kvacani katthaci kiñcanaṃ dosanīyesu dhammesu doso udapādi, mā me kvacani katthaci kiñcanaṃ mohanīyesu dhammesu moho udapādī'ti

21654.meaning1: what then?; how then?; what exactly?; how is it?; what just?; why?
21654.meaning2: how then? why then? how is it that… ?
21654.commentary: (MNa) atha kiñ'carahī'ti atha kasmā evaṃ ñāṇe asati tayā evaṃ kathitan'ti vadati. (SNt) atha kiñ'carahī'ti atha kasmā tvaṃ asampannagaṇaṃ bandhitvā carasī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: atha kiñ'carahi bhotā gotamena byākatan'ti?

atha kiñ'carahi tumhe, moghapurisā, kiṃ jānantā kiṃ passantā bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharatha, te na c'eva aññam'aññaṃ saññāpetha, na ca saññattiṃ upetha, na ca aññam'aññaṃ nijjhāpetha, na ca nijjhattiṃ upetha?

21655.meaning1: however much; even if; even though; although

examples.text: kiñ'c'āpi-ahaṃ, bhante, jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, desetu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ, desetu sugato saṃkhittena dhammaṃ, app'eva nām'āhaṃ bhagavato bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājāneyyaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ahi gūthagato kiñ'c'āpi na daṃsati, atha kho naṃ makkheti.

santi, bho gotama, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, yaṃ kiñc'āyaṃ purisapuggalo paṭisaṃvedeti sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham'asukhaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ pubbekatahetū'ti. idha bhavaṃ gotamo kim'āhā'ti?
paṭinissagg'ānupassī viharanto na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati
pariccattaṃ kho rañño nāgassa jīvitaṃ. n'atthi dāni kiñci rañño nāgassa akaraṇīyan'ti.

21658.grammar: pron, nt nom sg of kaci

examples.text: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atthi ca n'atthi ca aññaṃ kiñcī'ti? mā h'evaṃ, āvuso.
yaṃ kiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā yaṃ ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ. na no samaṃ atthi tathāgatena

21659.grammar: pron, masc & nt acc sg of kaci

examples.text: attaṃ pahāya anupādiyāno, ñāṇe'pi so nissayaṃ no karoti, sa ve viyattesu na vaggasārī, diṭṭhim'pi so na pacceti kiñci.

21660.grammar: pron, masc & nt acc sg of kaci

examples.text: iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā na sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti
yo ve kiñcikkhakamyatā, panthasmiṃ vajantaṃ janaṃ, hantvā kiñcikkham'ādeti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

21662.meaning1: generating something insignificant; creating trifling gain
21662.commentary: (SNa) kata kiñcikkhabhāvanā'ti katā kiñcikkhabhāvanā. ayam'eva vā pāṭho, āmisakiñcikkhassa vaḍḍhan'atthāya katan'ti attho.

examples.text: vaṇṇā ete brāhmaṇānaṃ, katā kiñcikkhabhāvanā, cittañ'ca susamāhitaṃ, vippasannam'anāvilaṃ, akhilaṃ sabbabhūtesu, so maggo brahmapattiyā'ti.

21663.meaning1: some matter; some point; some detail

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto aññabhāgiyassa adhikaraṇassa kiñcidesaṃ lesamattaṃ upādāya pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasantassa sākete kiñci'd'eva accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ uppajjeyya. tassa antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ satta rathavinītāni upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ.
sabbapaṭhamaṃ tāva kiñci'd'eva karuṇāyitabbarūpaṃ paramakicchappattaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ kapaṇapurisaṃ… kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.

21665.meaning1: any mental phenomenon; any state of mind

21666.commentary: (VIN) evañ'ca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattam'pī'ti. piṇḍapāto nāma yāgu'pi bhattam'pi khādanīyam'pi cuṇṇapiṇḍo'pi dantakaṭṭham'pi dasikasuttam'pi, antamaso dhammam'pi bhaṇati.

examples.text: app'eva nāma mayam'pi āyasmantānaṃ kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyyāmā'ti. evañ'ca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattam'pi, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

21668.meaning1: rule about (accusing someone of pārājika) on some pretext; Saṅghādisesa 9

examples.text: paṭhamam'p'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmī'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
ataramāno'va bhāseyya no taramāno'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?

21670.grammar: idiom, pron + ind + pron + ger + pp, interr
21670.meaning1: and in reference to what was this said?
